temporal_audit.metadata_basis: HPMS2020 linework,2022 study combines state-submitted HPMS/posted data; no individual speed effective dates.
temporal_audit.period_alignment: partial:2020 inventory year falls within study period, but2017–2021 speed-history consistency unverified

speed_unit_handling: Native numeric values retained without unit conversion. Layer field metadata does not explicitly encode units. No numerical predictor adopted.
coverage_method_limit: Buffered corridor intersection is potential road overlap, not verified road-link matching. Nearby parallel/local roads may be included. Coverage can differ by buffer and carriageway representation. NHS summed line length is not a city coverage ratio.

reasons: Insufficient citywide motorized-road corridor coverage even under broad buffer scenario.
Most eligible grid cells do not have adequate road-length coverage.
2020 record year does not establish posted speed effective throughout2017–2021.
Publisher-imputed values are present and must not be treated as directly observed.
